note: Fallback onboarding programmes per role; the agent composes one from the manual when available.

salesperson.title: Find your way around
salesperson.why: Knowing where things live saves you hours.
salesperson.task: Open the left menu and visit three pages; note the Help bubble in the bottom right.

salesperson.title: Search everything with Cmd+K
salesperson.why: One search box finds customers, cars, deals, job cards and manual chapters.
salesperson.task: Press Cmd+K (Ctrl+K on Windows) and search for a customer name.

salesperson.title: Ask Help your first question
salesperson.why: Help answers from the manual and cites the chapter, so you do not need to call anyone.
salesperson.task: Open Help and ask: "How do I add a memo?".

salesperson.title: Create your first lead
salesperson.why: Every enquiry becomes a lead with an owner.
salesperson.task: Create a lead, tag it onboarding and assign it to yourself.
salesperson.verifyHint: a lead you own tagged onboarding

salesperson.title: Book a test drive
salesperson.task: Book a test drive for your lead.

salesperson.title: Open a deal and read the summary
salesperson.why: The agent summarises a deal with citations.
salesperson.task: Open one of your deals and click the summary button.

service_manager.why: Job cards are the record of the visit.

service_manager.why: Ask which cards are waiting on parts.

service_manager.title: Quote from an Infomedia menu
